distinct_decisions.note: distinct decisions in the FULL frame. The tables report decision-evaluations, which are these times the ~40% test share times the repeat count.

interval_note: percentile spreads over re-splits describe how the estimator moves across partitions of one fixed set of decisions. They are NOT standard errors.

diagnose.note: full-frame fits, no re-splitting. beta_max is the largest coefficient on the transformed column that keeps beta'a > 0 for every alternative; above it the probability model is undefined and choice.py's 1e-300 floor silently optimises something that is not a likelihood.
